title: Algorithms Championship 2026 - National Qualifier
instructions: Welcome to the National Qualifier. You are permitted to use standard C/C++ libraries. Clipboard actions and external navigation are strictly prohibited. Your session is monitored.

problems.title: Problem 1: Array Parity Partition Sum
problems.description:
Given an array of integers of size `N`, compute the absolute difference between the sum of all even integers and the sum of all odd integers.

### Input Format
- The first line contains a single integer `N` representing the number of elements in the array.
- The second line contains `N` space-separated integers.

### Output Format
- Print a single integer: the absolute difference `|Sum(Even) - Sum(Odd)|`.

### Constraints
- 1 <= N <= 1000
- -10^5 <= Arr[i] <= 10^5

problems.title: Problem 2: Palindrome Substring Count
problems.description:
Given a single alphanumeric string `S` with no whitespace, count the total number of non-empty palindromic substrings of length >= 2 present in `S`.

### Input Format
- A single string `S` (length up to 250 characters).

### Output Format
- Print the integer count of palindromic substrings with length >= 2.

### Constraints
- 1 <= |S| <= 250
- Only lowercase English letters `[a-z]`.

problems.title: Problem 3: Matrix Spiral Layer Maximums
problems.description:
Given an `N x N` square matrix of integers, output the maximum element found along each concentric square border layer, proceeding from the outermost perimeter inward to the center.

### Input Format
- First line: Single integer `N` representing matrix dimension.
- Next `N` lines: `N` space-separated integers per line.

### Output Format
- Space-separated integers representing the maximum value of each concentric layer from outer to inner.

### Constraints
- 1 <= N <= 50
- -10^4 <= Matrix[i][j] <= 10^4
